name: Kanton Graubünden Beitragsgesuche Natur und Landschaft
summary: Canton Graubünden contributions for nature and landscape measures, including species protection and the care and enhancement of habitats, usually tied to a federal contribution. Applications are due by the end of March for measures carried out that year.

calls.label: Nature and landscape measures
calls.recurring: Applications due by the end of March each year, for measures carried out or at least begun in that year.
